correctionHistory.correction: The initial finding for 1SA 28:24 incorrectly suggested adding Saul. Re-read of fixed WEB 28:23–25 confirms 28:24 only describes the woman preparing the meal; Saul is neither named nor referred to by pronoun in that verse. The empty entity list is appropriate; the stale rationale is the actual finding. No map edit or Saul addition is recommended. 29:10 remains ambiguous because “your lord” is not uniquely Saul; 30:5 derived-place inconsistency finding remains.
